actions.name: Kwampirs RAT executes various cmd.exe commands for system and network reconnaissance

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT establishes persistence by creating a Windows service named WmiApSrvEx
actions.description: The Kwampirs RAT establishes persistence on the victim host by creating a service with the name WmiApSrvEx, display name WMI Performance Adapter Extension, with registry key \WmiApSrvEx and service image path %SystemRoot%\system32\Executable.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.
